scope: Availability-gated information-retention analysis and conditional cross-state identity diagnostic
full_hypothesis_gate: All required generic templates, independent profiles and frozen outcome labels must exist before a confirmatory model is fitted.

conditional_diagnostic.eligibility: Every target in the frozen complete-state cohort, including zero detected-response profiles
conditional_diagnostic.validation: Leave one state out; every target class has two other-state training profiles; nested tuning swaps the two training states
conditional_diagnostic.identity_label: Exact frozen target gene symbol; no gene names, target identifiers or target-specific missingness indicators are predictors
conditional_diagnostic.features: Frozen significant signed cis-normalized response coefficients; globally remove every feature matching a cohort target symbol, not only each row's cis gene
conditional_diagnostic.nuisance_fit: OLS response-on-covariates using training profiles only; remove the orthonormal span of fitted nuisance directions from training and test responses
conditional_diagnostic.state_average_boundary: Training-state mean directions are removed. An unobserved held-out-state-specific mean direction is not claimed to be removed.
conditional_diagnostic.missing_covariates: Training-median imputation with fixed zero fallback only when a training covariate is entirely unavailable
conditional_diagnostic.centroid: Arithmetic mean of the two training profiles of each target
conditional_diagnostic.centroid_score: Negative squared residual distance divided by median positive training squared residual norm
conditional_diagnostic.fingerprint_score: Cosine of residual query and target centroid; zero residual norm gives zero score for all classes
conditional_diagnostic.frozen_module_decoder: Cosine decoder in the unchanged 30-module loading basis after the common gene mask; this full-cohort basis is descriptive, not an independent validation basis
conditional_diagnostic.selection: Minimum mean inner-state log loss; ties choose the smallest inverse temperature; no outer-state tuning
conditional_diagnostic.score: log(K) + log predicted probability of the correct target, in nats, with K=4399
conditional_diagnostic.zero_profiles: Retain in the denominator. Prior probabilities replace no observations; zero vectors are detected-response zeros, not biological absence.
conditional_diagnostic.interpretation: Finite-sample conditional decoding score, an empirical variational lower-bound estimate for this balanced sampled-state task, not total molecular information or a causal entropy estimate

inference.conditional_permutation: Permute query target labels within held-out state, target-expression quintile and response-degree quintile; equal covariate values stay in the same bin
inference.network_degree_boundary: No independent network-degree annotation is supplied among the assigned frozen inputs. The full prespecified degree-matched null is unavailable; the partial matched diagnostic is not substituted for it.
inference.permutation_tail: One-sided observed decoding score greater than the matched-label null
inference.permutation_scope: Fixed trained decoder, evaluating cross-state identity alignment; no claim of a full model-refitting randomization test
inference.bh_family: Nine conditional diagnostic state-by-nonprior-decoder tests, separate from the unavailable H12-H17 confirmatory family
inference.state_contrasts: Three paired state differences for the fixed RNA-fingerprint comparator; two-sided centered target bootstrap and separate BH family
inference.calibration: Ten equal-width confidence bins; descriptive top-label calibration slope and intercept; posterior label-set coverage at 50, 80 and 95 percent; these are not conformal prediction intervals
inference.influence: Leave-one-target change in mean conditional score; no refitting claim

stopping.validated_outputs: Do not refit or alter existing transfer models, classes or module bases
stopping.ridge_multinomial: Do not fit the confirmatory regularized multinomial model or its regularization grid while the required generic-template and independent-profile gates fail
stopping.equivalence_classes: Do not estimate without profile-resolved reliability, the 20/30/40 resolution inputs, negative genes and all frozen 80-percent stability checks
stopping.external: H16-H17 remain unavailable until the deferred input contract and equivalence gates are satisfied
stopping.primary_information_pass: False unless required adjustment, positive lower-bound interval, guide/donor replication and corrected independent external association all pass
